Class ExecutorServiceItem<T extends TaskTideModel<T>>

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.engine.trackers.ExecutorServiceItem<T>
Type Parameters:
T - TaskTideModel of type WorkItem/ItemTask
public class ExecutorServiceItem<T extends TaskTideModel<T>> extends Object
Holds reference for the future TaskTideModel so that their processing can be tracked as a collection.
